remarks: This gracious colonial style home lends itself to comfortable living throughout. The spacious chef's eat-in kitchen, formal dining room, living room with fireplace, study, and first floor bedroom and bath complete this level. Upstairs three oversized bedrooms offer great space, and the finished walk-out lower level with second fireplace suggest additional living areas.  The charming screened porch and expansive decking overlook lovely property, in a location that is convenient to New Canaan town center. There is a bedroom and bath on the first level, and three bedrooms upstairs. Any one of the bedrooms can be used as a Primary Bedroom.         Listing Realtor is related to seller. Lower level microwave and wine refrigerator do not work.
